summary: A candidate for statewide office travels to another part of the state to maintain a relationship there.
realLife: Dick Clark’s 1972 Iowa Senate campaign took him on foot through farming communities, suburbs and city business districts. He covered more than a thousand miles before the election.
inGame: needs: record the campaign stop and earlier relationship in the same scene.

turns.what: The candidate reschedules the visit with the same host.
turns.pulledBy: A chamber sitting conflicts with the original travel day.
turns.writesBack: The itinerary carries a new date for the existing commitment.

turns.what: The candidate reaches the host’s county but spends the visit at the host’s shop during a shift change.
turns.pulledBy: The host cannot leave work and has agreed to meet at the shop.
turns.writesBack: The visit log names the host and the people who could actually attend.
